<div class="card-body">
'''Wedge Antilles''' is a [[Light]] [[Character]] from [[Reflections III: A Collector's Bounty|Reflections III: A Collector's Bounty]].

<h2>Title</h2>
<span lang="ja">ウェッジ・アンティリーズ</span><ref name="jp-face" />
<h2>Card Text</h2>
<span lang="ja">彼の操縦する宇宙船の戦闘力に3を加える。レッド2に搭乗しているなら、さらに回避値に2を加え、戦闘運命数を引けない場合も1枚引ける。1フォース消費して自分のリザーブ・デッキの中から「コレリアン・スリップ」を1枚探して手札に入れることができる。その後デッキをシャッフルし、カットして元の場所に置く。</span><ref name="jp-face" />
<h2>Lore</h2>
''<span lang="ja">コレリア人の英雄。ヤヴィンの戦いでレッド2を駆る。事故で失った両親の遺産が充分にあり、貨物船を購入することができた。当初は武器の密輸屋として同盟軍に荷担していた。</span>''<ref name="jp-face" />
<h2>Translation of Japanese Text</h2>
'''Title:''' Wedge Antilles.

'''Card text:''' Adds 3 to the power of a starship he pilots. When aboard Red 2, also adds 2 to maneuver and may draw one battle destiny if not able to otherwise. May use 1 Force to search your Reserve Deck and take one Corellian Slip into hand. Shuffle, cut and replace.

'''Lore:''' A Corellian hero. He flew Red 2 at the Battle of Yavin. The inheritance from his parents, lost in an accident, was enough that he could buy a freighter. At first he aided the Alliance as a weapons smuggler.

'''Comparison with the English printing:''' The Japanese names コレリアン・スリップ for Corellian Slip.
<h2>Notes</h2>
'''Wedge Antilles (Japanese Reflections III Foil)''' is a Japanese-language foil printing of [[Wedge Antilles|Wedge Antilles]]. [[Decipher]] released it in [[Reflections III: A Collector's Bounty]] in October 2001. The ordinary Japanese expansion printing is [[Wedge Antilles (Japanese)]]. Complete Card List v4 lists checklist R75 at rarity SR. Collector R-numbers are checklist references, not GEMP blueprint IDs.<ref name="checklist">[https://res.starwarsccg.org/Resources/swccgcardlist4.0.pdf Star Wars Customizable Card Game Complete Card List v4.0], p. 31, Reflections III foil cards, R75. Preserved copy: [https://web.archive.org/web/20261009184033/https://res.starwarsccg.org/Resources/swccgcardlist4.0.pdf Internet Archive].</ref><ref name="encyc">[https://res.starwarsccg.org/Resources/Star_Wars_CCG_Collecting_Encyclopedia_3.2.pdf SWCCG Collecting Encyclopedia 3.2], p. 22. Preserved copy: [https://web.archive.org/web/20261008192828/https://res.starwarsccg.org/Resources/Star_Wars_CCG_Collecting_Encyclopedia_3.2.pdf Internet Archive].</ref><ref name="jp-face">[[:File:Japanese-Wedge-Antilles-Reflections-III-Foil-SWCA.jpg|Original Japanese foil face]]. Photograph by Duncan Jenkins.</ref>
